My name is Brady! I'm an aspiring Data Scientist from Denver, currently finishing the final semester of my Masters in Statistics from CU Denver. On top of that I'm also working for CLA as a Data Scientist as a part of their internal research and development team. My time there will be wrapping up soon in December, so I'm actively pursuing other opportunities at the moment! 

I primarily work in Python, and my previous work experience lends itself mostly to machine learning in databricks. However, I'm comfortable with most parts of DS work and have enjoyed everything I've experienced so far! In general I like to think I know enough to get myself into (and hopefully out of) trouble.

I used to have a very long blurb on this site but let's keep it short now! I love statistics, scripting, hiking, bouldering, retro video games and horror movies. I also do some hobbiest photography on the side, I used to use a portfolio site for that but now I just link to my Flickr account.
